headline: Holistic Health Assessment, from entry to detail
overview: Comprehensive health assessment across 8 dimensions. Evaluate your physical, mental, emotional, social, spiritual, environmental, occupational, and financial health to get a full picture of your overall wellbeing.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Holistic Health Assessment — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the 8-dimension holistic health assessment interface with dimension categories and scoring.
steps.screenshotAlt: Holistic Health Assessment landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Visual radar chart showing your health profile at a glance
Identify your strongest and weakest health dimensions
Personalized recommendations for improvement in each dimension
tips: Take the assessment during a calm moment — you'll get more honest and reflective answers than when you're stressed or rushed.
Retake the assessment every 3 months to track how your holistic health profile evolves over time.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
